seo.title: Multiples of 12 Speed Grid - 12s Times Table Fluency Game
seo.metaDescription: Find all multiples of 12 on a 100-tile math grid. Practice dozen groupings and advanced multiplication facts before time runs out.
seo.intro: The twelve times table is a crucial benchmark in measurement systems, representing hours on clock faces, inches in a foot, and items in a dozen. Multiples of 12 are numbers that can be divided evenly by both 3 and 4. Up to 100, exactly 8 multiples of 12 exist. Mastering these 8 numbers cements upper multiplication recall and prepares students for work with common denominators.
seo.howToPlay: Find and click all multiples of 12 from 1 to 100. Correct multiples highlight green with a checkmark. Misclicks flash red and penalize 2 seconds. Find all 8 multiples of 12 before the clock expires.
seo.teacherNotes: Connect the 12 times table to real-world units: dozens of eggs, 12 inches in a foot, and 24 hours in a day.

faq.q: What are the multiples of 12 up to 100?
What is a quick test for divisibility by 12?
faq.a: A number is divisible by 12 if its last two digits form a multiple of 4 AND the sum of its digits is divisible by 3.
